FROM superhero

WHERE superhero.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190

SELECT 
  (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM atom a2 
    WHERE a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.element = 'f'
  ) THEN m.molecule_id END) * 100.0 / 
   COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)) AS percentage
FROM 
  molecule m

    SELECT MAX(match_count)

FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012-08%' THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS August2012Spending,
    SUM(Amount) AS TotalSpending
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508

SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    SUM(p.ViewCount) AS TotalPopularity
FROM 
    users u
JOIN 
    posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE 
    u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY 
    u.DisplayName
ORDER BY 
    TotalPopularity DESC

WITH MarkMeckesPosts AS (
    SELECT Id, Tags
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes')
    AND CommentCount = 0
    AND Tags IS NOT NULL
),
SplitTags AS (
    SELECT 
        Id,
        SUBSTR(Tags, 2, INSTR(Tags, '>') - 2) AS Tag,
        SUBSTR(Tags, INSTR(Tags, '>') + 1) AS RemainingTags
    FROM MarkMeckesPosts
    WHERE Tags LIKE '%<%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        Id,
        SUBSTR(RemainingTags, 2, INSTR(RemainingTags, '>') - 2) AS Tag,
        SUBSTR(RemainingTags, INSTR(RemainingTags, '>') + 1) AS RemainingTags
    FROM SplitTags
    WHERE RemainingTags LIKE '%<%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT Tag
FROM SplitTags
WHERE Tag != ''

FROM superhero

FROM schools s

FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    SUM(b.spent) / SUM(b.amount) AS spend_to_budget_ratio
FROM 
    event e
JOIN 
    budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE

GROUP BY 
    e.event_id, e.event_name

LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM_1996 = 0 THEN NULL 
    ELSE (SUM_1997 - SUM_1996) / SUM_1996 * 100 
  END AS growth_rate
FROM (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS SUM_1997,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS SUM_1996
  FROM 
    loan l
  JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M' AND 
    strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
) AS loan_sums

WITH player_heights AS (
  SELECT MAX(height) as max_height, MIN(height) as min_height
  FROM Player
),
highest_player_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(Player_Attributes.finishing) as avg_finishing
  FROM Player_Attributes
  JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
  JOIN player_heights ON Player.height = player_heights.max_height
),
shortest_player_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(Player_Attributes.finishing) as avg_finishing
  FROM Player_Attributes
  JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
  JOIN player_heights ON Player.height = player_heights.min_height
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT avg_finishing FROM highest_player_avg) > (SELECT avg_finishing FROM shortest_player_avg) 
    THEN 'highest' 
    ELSE 'shortest' 
  END as result
FROM highest_player_avg

WITH czk_customers_2013 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        ym.Consumption
    FROM 
        customers c
    JOIN 
        yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
),
segment_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM 
        czk_customers_2013
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
),
min_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        c.Consumption
    FROM 
        czk_customers_2013 c
    JOIN 
        segment_min_consumption s ON c.Segment = s.Segment AND c.Consumption = s.min_consumption
),
segment_avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM 
        min_consumption_customers
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') -

SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /

SELECT

        -- Convert time to seconds
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +  -- hours
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +   -- minutes
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +         -- seconds
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000  -- milliseconds
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    races r
JOIN 
    results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year < 1975
    AND (res.position = 1 OR res.positionText = '1')
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
    AND res.time NOT LIKE '+%'  -- Exclude times that start with '+'
GROUP BY 
    r.year
ORDER BY 
    r.year

  FROM races
  WHERE year = 1988 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

champion AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, r.time AS champion_time, r.milliseconds AS champion_milliseconds
  FROM results r

  JOIN race_info ri ON r.raceId = ri.raceId
  WHERE r.position = 1
),
last_finisher AS (

  FROM results r
  JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId

  l.last_time,
  -- Calculate incremental time in milliseconds
  (l.last_milliseconds - c.champion_milliseconds) AS incremental_time_ms,

    SELECT 
        s.School AS SchoolName,
        s.County,
        sr.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sr.AvgScrRead DESC) AS CountyRank
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        satscores sr ON s.CDSCode = sr.cds
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual = 'F' AND sr.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    SchoolName
FROM 
    RankedSchools
WHERE 
    CountyRank <= 5
ORDER BY 
    County, CountyRank
